Dessers obviously not had as much game time  as he had previously but are you pleased for  
him to come in today start and score a hat  trick of course because it shows what I’ve  
been saying all the time that I’m here  Cyriel is a really great character to  
have in the dressing room in the team always  works hard of course he’s not happy if he can  
not get more minutes like he had in the  past to play that many minutes but that’s  
the yeah football at the highest level it’s  competition but he kept on working he kept on  
fighting that’s why he’s ready also to play  these games and to score a hat trick then
you asked last week about younger players getting  more of a chance in your team how how do you think  
they acquitted themselves today I thought Finlay  Cuts in particular looked really really confident  
when he came on fantastic pass for Ross’s goal  yeah two two really good passes from Finlay so  
yeah indeed he’s one of the guys who’s developing  really well the last couple of months who trained  
also a lot of times with us but there are others  also so it’s difficult for me to point out one Zak  
is coming back out of a long injury Bailie Rice  is doing really good things in training that’s why  
I wanted to give him also minutes but there are  also guys like Pau who is not in the squad today  
who’s making a good evolution so it’s about all  of them to keep on working hard to be hungry to  
have the desire to become better and then to push  the others and to make next steps like Clinton for  
example is doing now and challenging for positions  with other players so that’s what we need and  
that’s also what this club needs to develop young  players who can play at the best level and that’s  
winning every game so there is the big gap to make  between academy and playing first team football  
here because it’s not only first team football  it’s about the demand of every game to win it  
also so it’s also a mentality thing it’s character  thing and Finlay scoring did good points today
what’s the plan for these young players the B  team situation what is the plan for the young  
players that they will keep on playing games like  they’ve been doing the last couple of months also  
playing games training with us and guys who get  yeah who deserve the chance to be with the first  
team to be with the first team and with other  players there have been several players who have  
gone on loan to get more playing time like Cole  McKinnon who was already several years in the  
first team squad or around like Robbie Fraser  also that they can get every week the minutes  
the guys who are still here are more the guys  who need his experience with sometimes playing  
in parts playing and training also more with  the first team so it’s a little bit in between
you said before you were quite enthusiastic about  sending young players on loan because you like you  
don’t have the control has there been a change  of thinking no I said that the ideal situation  
is that like in a lot of countries we spoke about  that Holland Belgium Spain they have their second  
team playing in a second league or third league  that should be much better for Scottish football  
if that could happen another thing that was for  me surprising yesterday when I hear that for the  
Scottish Cup there’s one spot less on the bench  than last season so otherwise I would have had  
one young player more on the bench so I don’t  know why this rule is changed I don’t think it  
benefits the young players in Scottish football  also something to think about but it’s a better  
situation if you can let them play every week  and you have total control of the story with  
your own coach manager there your own performance  team for all the physical work and everything so  
that’s the ideal situation but it’s not possible  here so we need to find other solution and it’s  
then it becomes more an individual story what  does every player need at this moment in time
you said that if Cyriel couldn’t play he’d have a  discussion with you has that happened yet we have  
discussions every day no not every day that’s  that’s not true but at least every week or yeah  
we talk all the time so that’s it I think Cyriel  shows that he has desire to do everything for this  
club and of course he wants to play every game  then showing that you’re the best that’s that’s  
working at Rangers he knows that also really  well so that’s the situation for the moment
one last one Europe next week Thursday night  do you go down to Old Trafford with feeling  
no pressure does it feel like you’re close to  yes I want pressure to be to be very clear I I  
want pressure I want pressure on the team I want  my team to be ambitious and if we are somewhere  
that we have higher ambitions to make it better so  that’s what we’re going to do the team has worked  
really hard to be in a good position in this  Europa League they did really well in this Europa  
League we know what Manchester United is we know  their level but we’re going to go there to fight  
and to show ourselves and to do something  really special that’s our ambition to go  
there and to do something special okay guys  thank you very much said last one last one  
last last one about Cyriel beyond this window  he’s talking about his future and potentially  
having to go somewhere else to play do you hope  that he stays here do you see a big part of your  
plan it’s a difficult question that one if Cyriel  goes you need to replace him and it needs to be  
at least the same quality if a player stays and he  plays less and he becomes because of that unhappy  
and it goes down his level what I don’t fear with  him it’s also not good for the club so we will  
see in the in the next two weeks what happens I  know if he’s here he will give everything for the  
club and if he leaves he needs to be replaced  by somebody at least from the same quality
